integrity: The proof is symbolic. A standalone exhaustive checker reconstructs subgroup lattices and paired-domination numbers for ten representative finite abelian groups.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for finite abelian groups and the standard intersection graph on all proper nontrivial subgroups.
No claim is made for nonabelian groups or for graphs restricted to selected subgroup classes.
Previously known ordinary and total domination facts are used only as lower bounds or structural input; the final claim is the paired-domination classification.
title: Paired domination in subgroup intersection graphs of finite abelian groups
